documents.title: Receipt Of Trading Approval For 15,01,434 Equity Shares Of Face Value Rs. 2/- Each

analysis.summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call on July 28, 2026, reporting a turnover of over 700 crores and a PAT of 20 crores. Management noted that while trade route disruptions and material shortages in April and May initially reduced sales volumes to 5,200 tons, things normalized in June with 2,200 tons dispatched in that month alone. The company achieved its highest-ever EBITDA margin of 5.43% and PAT margin of 2.87% for the quarter. Furthermore, management discussed ongoing corporate restructuring to form Tieramet Limited, market demand trends, and strategic initiatives in value-added copper products. Bhagyanagar India Limited reported Q1FY27 consolidated revenue of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company expects to maintain its EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5% for the rest of the year.
guidance.quote: Going forward in the year, we hope to maintain the EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5%.

guidance.claim: Management targets an export contribution of 12% to 15% for the year.
guidance.quote: 12-15% would be a good estimate for the year.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of achieving 5,000 crores in revenue by FY30 regardless of copper prices.
guidance.quote: But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

guidance.claim: Management targets ending the year with a value-added product share between 63% and 64%.
guidance.quote: In terms of our value-added percentage, we are looking at between 63% and 64% for this year.

guidance.claim: Management targets a top-line projection of 5,000 crores in the year 2030.
guidance.quote: Our top line projection, as in earlier, this thing, has been project... we are aiming for 3,000 crores in the year 2030. That is, in 3 years, we are planning to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030.

guidance.claim: Management stated that 25% CAGR is their target for the next 3 to 4 years.
guidance.quote: 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.claim: Management expects volume growth of 20% and a 5% increase in prices out of the targeted 25% growth.
guidance.quote: Out of the 25%, we are expecting 20% volume growth and 5% increase in prices.

guidance.claim: Management is hopeful of maintaining a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year on an increased top line.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

demand_outlook.claim: India is projected to consume around 2.4 million metric tons of copper by 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: As we can see, India is actually one of the fastest growing copper users in the world, with around 2.4 million metric tons projected to be consumed in India by 2030.

demand_outlook.claim: Secondary copper demand in India is expected to double from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons in the next 5 years.
demand_outlook.quote: Out of this, if you look at the secondary copper demand, it is expected to double in the next 5 years, from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons.

demand_outlook.claim: The recycled copper market in India is estimated to grow at a CAGR of about 12-13%.
demand_outlook.quote: The recycled copper market, by some estimates, should be growing in India at a CAGR of about 12-13%.

demand_outlook.claim: Primary copper refining charges have gone negative because available ore and concentrate go to China due to high sulphuric acid prices.
demand_outlook.quote: So, first, about the primary copper, just a small update. You know, the refining charges in primary copper have gone negative, because whatever ore and concentrate is available in the world is all going to China. And it is going to China because the price of the byproduct of copper, sulphuric acid, is very, very high in China.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.
demand_outlook.quote: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that growth will mainly be driven by EV and automotive, power and electrification, and renewable energy sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: This growth will mainly be driven by three sectors, EV and automotive. Because, EV requires a lot more copper than regular cars, power and electrification is also a big growth factor, and renewable energy.

capex_expansion.claim: The management has proposed a capex of 40 crores over FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed adding a capacity of 35,000 metric tons which is now online.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also finished adding our capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.

capex_expansion.claim: The next capacity expansion from 35,000 to 45,000 tons is projected for around June of next financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: So, this has been projected for the next financial year. The exact timelines are still not there, but as of now, our expectation is between April and June of next year; more likely June next year. From 35,000 to 45,000 tons.

capex_expansion.claim: Management proposed a capex of 40 crores in the next 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: We are proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported its highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: We have achieved sales volumes of 5,200 tons. We have also had our highest share of value-added products sold this quarter, which is 63% and our highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees.

margins_costs.claim: Automobile and switchgear components have double-digit margins while the rest are in single digits.
margins_costs.quote: Auto and switchgewairll have double digits; the rest of it will all be in single digits.

margins_costs.claim: Removal of customs duty from January 1, 2025, has helped increase company margins.
margins_costs.quote: Also, the customs duty has been removed from 1st January 2025, so that has also helped us increase our margins.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported a Q1FY27 EBITDA margin of 5.43%.
The company reported a Q1FY27 PAT margin of 2.87%.
Management noted that the silver-bearing and tin-bearing bus bars will give them roughly about 10% EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: So, we are, this product will give us roughly about 10%, EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the company achieved an EBITDA per kg of around 43 rupees for the year.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees, which is very high compared to our peers, and as you can see, over the four quarters, our EBITDA per kg has been trending upwards.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported achieving around 62 rupees per kg in EBITDA per kg for quarter four.
margins_costs.quote: With the quarter four, we achieved around 62 rupees per kg.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volumes for the quarter came down to 5,200 tons, with 2,200 tons coming in the month of June alone.
orders_capacity.quote: However, for the whole quarter, our volume has come down to 5,200 tons. But the good part of this is that 2,200 tons of the 5,200 tons has come only in the month of June.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's sales volumes dropped by 9.5% from the last quarter and 6.5% from last year to 5,278 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Our sales volumes have dropped, though; they have gone to 5,278 tons, which is a 9.5% decrease from the last quarter and a 6.5% decrease from last year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company supplied roughly 250 tons of tin-coated products during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: This quarter, we did roughly about 250 tons of the tin-coated products.

orders_capacity.claim: CTC and enamelled wires production capacity is about 80 metric tons a month and is going up to 150 metric tons a month.
orders_capacity.quote: On CTC wires, our capacity is roughly about 80 metric tons a month and we will be going up to 150 metric tons a month.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that their capacity has reached 35,000 metric tonne this year.
orders_capacity.quote: Our capacity has now reached 35,000 metric tonne this year, with the new, 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.

orders_capacity.claim: Management noted that copper sales volume grew by 34% to 24,000 metric tonne last year.
orders_capacity.quote: Last year, we did around 18,000 metric tonne of volume of copper sales. Which has gone up by 34% to, 2 24,000 metric tonne.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has finalized the first round of fund raising at 52 crores, with the money expected in the bank in August.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we have just finalized the first round of raising, at 52 crores, which is finalized, and the money should be in the bank in the month of August.

capital_allocation.claim: Long-term projections show that debt in 2030 will be between 300 and 350 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our projection is showing that between 300 and 350 crores will be our debt in 2030.

capital_allocation.claim: The total fund raise through preferential allotment is Rs. 52.25 Crores.
Management noted that the increase in equity was not done through dilution, but entirely through retained earnings.
capital_allocation.quote: And then from 207 to 257. And this increase in equity was not done through dilution, this was all done through retained earnings.

risks_headwinds.claim: Trade route disruptions and material shortages in the first two months caused turnover to come down.
risks_headwinds.quote: In the first two months, because of the disruption of all the trade routes and the shortage of material all over the country, while the turnover came down, we could take advantage of the situation by increasing our margins.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that copper scrap coming from the Gulf has suddenly dried up and short lead time material has been affected.
risks_headwinds.quote: The scrap coming from Gulf, which is of a short duration, short lead time material, has suddenly dried up.

management_commitments.claim: The management proposed to do 40 crores of capex over FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans a complete digital transformation over the next year.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next year, we are going to do a complete digital transformation of our company, where every process, every department and all reporting will be completely digitalized automatically, and no manual entry would be required.

management_commitments.claim: The company is confident of reaching 5,000 crores in revenue by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: So, see, the copper prices are out of our control. At 15% volume growth, you can do the reverse math based on the copper prices to see when we achieve it. But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to reach 5,000 crores in revenue in the year 2030.
management_commitments.quote: That is, in 3 years, we are planning to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to scale up plastic recycling over the next year.
management_commitments.quote: So this is, going to... we're going to scale this up in... over the next year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
